changelog.note: 231 (stage F, F3 D4; the owner's decision of 2026-10-29: the downloads follow the interface's language): the utilities' names and the reconciliation statement's labels (sheet names, heading, columns, results, reasons, sources, yes and no) are English sources; their Hungarian comes from the interface's dictionary (ui/src/i18n/hu-native.json), and the statement and the utility cost are written in the requesting interface's language. The file name's parts are unchanged.

145 (DECISIONS 132, 145; backlog F-reconciliation E3b): reconcile_statement - the labels of a reconciliation package's statement downloaded as an Excel workbook with two sheets, invoices and lines (jav/reconcile_statement.py): the file name's parts, the sheet names, the heading block, the columns the field names of field_labels.json do not give, the results of an invoice and a line, the reasons (a person's needs-no-invoice mark, the code's exclusion; the same wording as the interface's Hungarian translation) and the sources. Display vocabulary, in Hungarian.

054 K4 (decisions of 2026-09-28): the utility cost series - split by consumption place and utility, a monthly grid, apportioned by day; the shared water summary (the Díjbeszedő cover sheet) is for information only, as its part bills come in as documents of their own too (counting twice)
